definitions.explanation: Being in a lower or weaker position relative to others, whether in competition, ability, rank, or negotiating power.

examples.japanese: {劣位|れつい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}たされる。
examples.english: To be placed at a disadvantage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{劣位|れつい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: To be in an inferior position technologically.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{劣位|れつい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}たない→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧よう⟦{準備|じゅんび}する→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧。
examples.english: To prepare so as not to be at a disadvantage in negotiations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{劣位|れつい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挽回|ばんかい}→挽回：16313_bankai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{戦略|せんりゃく}→戦略：04869_senryaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}ち{出|だ}した→打ち出す：06790_uchidasu⟧。
examples.english: They launched a new strategy to recover from their inferior market position.

notes:
A formal term describing an inferior or disadvantaged position, often used in business, military, academic, and competitive contexts. Typically contrasted with ⟦{優位|ゆうい}→優位：11531_yuui⟧ (superiority, advantageous position).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {劣位|れつい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand in an inferior position
- {劣位|れつい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}たされる: to be placed at a disadvantage
- {劣位|れつい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be in an inferior position
- {劣位|れつい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挽回|ばんかい}→挽回：16313_bankai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to recover from a disadvantage
- ⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧{劣位|れつい}: competitive disadvantage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{優位|ゆうい}→優位：11531_yuui⟧: superiority, advantageous position — the direct opposite
- ⟦{劣勢|れっせい}→劣勢：08647_ressei⟧: inferiority, losing position — emphasizes being on the losing side in a contest
- ⟦{不利|ふり}→不利：03603_furi⟧: disadvantage — more common in everyday usage
- ⟦{下位|かい}→下位：11710_kai⟧: lower rank, lower position — refers to ranking rather than competitive strength

FORMS:
{劣|れつ} (inferior, worse) + ⟦{位|い}→〜位：00443_i⟧ (rank, position) — literally "inferior rank."
